title: Staff Product Manager - AI Detection & Discovery
description: Strength in Trust  OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.   The Challenge   You cannot govern what you cannot see. AI is entering the enterprise faster than any technology before it—often without a ticket: a team deploys a foundation model endpoint in an unmonitored cloud account, an engineer self-hosts an open-weight model, or a SaaS vendor quietly adds an AI feature to a widely used tool.   OneTrust is looking for a Staff Product Manager to own Detection—the discovery layer that finds AI models, LLM applications, agents, and AI-enabled features wherever they run, and turns that visibility into a governable inventory. Detection is the front door to AI governance: every downstream risk assessment, policy control, and compliance obligation depends on the completeness and accuracy of what you surface.   Your Mission   Strategy & Roadmap   Own product strategy for the Detection area across multiple related products, balancing delivery across the full product line. Set the Shadow AI detection strategy: discover unsanctioned models, applications, and agents; attribute owners; risk-rank assets; and route them into governance and remediation workflows. Define and sequence the coverage roadmap across detection surfaces, weighing build vs. partner decisions, connector investment, and the risk retired by each incremental surface. Establish the  detection taxonomy and definition of a “discovered AI asset,” bringing models, hosted endpoints, fine-tunes, RAG pipelines, agents, and embedded vendor features into one coherent inventory. Own the quality bar with measurable targets for coverage, precision, recall, time-to-discovery, and false-positive  rate ; make tradeoffs explicit. Identify adjacent opportunities, including continuous monitoring, AI bill of materials, third-party and supply-chain AI risk, and usage telemetry.   Cross-Functional Leadership   Lead geographically distributed engineering, design, data science, and detection research teams through ambiguous, discovery-heavy problems. Align with Product Marketing, Sales, and Partners on positioning and go-to-market in a category where buyers compare coverage claims. Partner with Security, IT, and Legal stakeholders—internally  and at design-partner customers—to test detection signals against real enterprise adoption. Work with Ecosystem and Partnerships on cloud marketplaces and integrations with adjacent tools (CSPM, SSPM, CASB, IdP, EDR, and SaaS management) where telemetry can be shared rather than rebuilt.   Technical & Domain Depth   Serve as the Detection subject matter expert while building knowledge of adjacent AI governance and privacy products. Bring deep understanding of AI deployment, including managed model services (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI), commercial LLM APIs, self-hosted open-weight models and inference servers, fine-tuning and training pipelines, vector databases, RAG architectures, and agent frameworks. Understand detection mechanics well enough to make hard approach decisions across API and control-plane enumeration, log and network telemetry, OAuth and identity analysis, code and dependency scanning, endpoint and browser signals, and vendor questionnaires or attestations where technical discovery cannot reach. Translate requirements from the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging state AI laws into concrete detection and inventory requirements.   Escalation & Communication   Serve as the primary escalation point for the product line, de-escalating issues and communicating clearly from individual engineers to executives. Represent  Detection strategy with customers, analysts, and prospects, and bring those insights back into the roadmap.   Mentorship   Informally mentor Product Managers and Associate Product Managers, sharing strategic and domain expertise . Raise the broader product organization’s bar for reasoning about AI systems, detection quality, and evidence-based prioritization.   You Are   A subject matter expert who handles significant complexity and exercises independent judgment. title: IT Risk Manager, BT Risk Management
description: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team Workday’s Business Technology (BT) organization continues its mission to deliver unparalleled value to our business partners and customers. To support this mission, the BT Strategy & Operations team is responsible for developing the long-term vision for BT, setting goals and objectives, and ensuring that we have the right plans in place to move with speed at scale. The team collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, business partners, and executives to understand the needs and priorities of the business, and supports the development of strategies that will help BT meet those needs. About the Role Key Responsibilities: Program Development and Implementation (Strategy & Framework): Assist with the Design and Formalization of the BT Risk Management Framework: Assist with the design and development of the new, formal, and comprehensive BT Risk Management Program, clarifying roles, responsibilities, and a standardized framework for risk buy down prioritization. Drive Compliance and Policy Enhancement: Review and enhance the BT compliance strategy, including controls and procedures, with regard to industry trends and upcoming regulatory activity, ensuring BT maintains its commitment to running secure and reliable systems Establish a program to ensure application and controls information accuracy: Collaborate with Architecture, Engineering and Asset Management team to ensure ongoing accuracy of application, control and risk acceptance information. Operational Risk Assessment and Mitigation (Execution): Lead Risk & Control Analysis: Work with business units and stakeholders, including Security, Internal Audit, BT, and Compliance, to formally assess security issues/gaps and identify potential operational risks. Manage Remediation & Follow-Up: Clearly communicate the impact of security issues and gaps to business management and agree on precise remediation actions and timelines. Manage follow-up programs to ensure timely completion of all Management Action Plans. Project Leadership: Lead a project to establish and perform a risk assessment process for BT technology. Lead ongoing projects to address GRC-related findings, demonstrating immediate value and embedding a culture of proactive risk management. Organizational Engagement and Partnerships: Cultivate Strategic Partnerships: Build and maintain strong, effective partnerships with BT leaders and cross-functional partners to foster a collaborative and supportive environment. This is essential to drive the collective objective of "Doing Things Right". Lead Change Management: Lead change management efforts to overcome resistance and drive adoption of new security behaviors and risk processes across the organization, simplifying the path to compliance. Metric-Driven Continuous Improvement: Establish Outcome-Driven Metrics (ODMs): Define, implement, and track ODMs to measure the effectiveness of risk management, compliance, and control activities. Refine Program via Data-Driven Insights: Continuously refine initiatives based on organizational feedback and data-driven insights from metrics to ensure the BT Risk Management program maintains alignment with strategic objectives. About You Basic Qualifications: 8+ years experience in GRC, developing and implementing GRC policies and procedures. 8+ years of experience conducting internal audits, and managing regulatory compliance. 8+ years of experience in risk assessment methodologies, control frameworks, and regulatory requirements. Other Qualifications: Strong knowledge of internal controls, audit procedures, and compliance regulations. Experience designing federal SaaS cloud computing systems. Experience with Intelligence, DOD, and other federal programs. Successful record of implementing and improving operational processes as it pertains to risk management

title: Director, Cybersecurity

Built to provide a centralized view of risk and complia nce, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform. The GRC Market Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale.    Director, Cybersecurity Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid) About the Role The Director, Cybersecurity drives the execution of LogicGate’s internal security and compliance program, protecting our SaaS platform and reinforcing enterprise customer trust. Reporting directly to the CISO, you will lead the security organization, operationalize risk management, and scale our SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP compliance frameworks. In a business building GRC software for global enterprises, your security program serves as both a foundational shield and a direct catalyst for enterprise sales. You will develop high-performing security teams, partner cross-functionally across Engineering and Product, and represent our security posture credibly to enterprise buyers. What You’ll Do Program Execution: Operationalize LogicGate’s enterprise security roadmap in partnership with the CISO, translating strategic objectives into daily InfoSec and IT security operations that safeguard customer data and platform integrity. People Leadership: Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing security organization—serving as the Deputy CISO—fostering a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and strong team engagement. Compliance Readiness: Own LogicGate’s enterprise compliance posture, ensuring that our security program aligns with frameworks such as SOC 2 Type II, ISO27001, ISO 42001, FedRamp, etc. Customer Trust: Serve as the senior security voice in high-stakes enterprise customer engagements, conducting security reviews and fielding questionnaires to accelerate sales cycles and build buyer confidence. AI & Security Innovation: Evaluate and integrate modern AI tools, threat detection technologies, and automated workflows into security operations to optimize incident response times and program efficiency. Governance, Risk, & Compliance: Maintain LogicGate’s security governance framework, overseeing vendor risk assessments, security policies, incident response readiness, and company-wide security awareness programs. Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner directly with Engineering, Product, Legal, and Operations leadership to embed security best practices into product development and operational workflows.   What You Bring Required: Security Leadership Experience: 7-10 years of progressive information security experience, including 4+ years leading security teams and owning end-to-end security operations, incident response, security engineering, vulnerability management, security architecture, and compliance programs. Enterprise Compliance Mastery: Proven track record as the primary owner in deploying and maintaining security tools and processes that aligns with SOC 2 Type II compliance requirements and security governance frameworks within a high-growth SaaS environment. Technical Acumen: Demonstrated expertise serving as an incident response commander, with deep technical knowledge across CNAPP, EDR, and SASE architecture. Executive & Customer Presence: Demonstrated expertise communicating complex technical risks to executive stakeholders, board members, auditors, and enterprise customer security teams. AI Literacy & Automation: Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience leveraging modern AI tools, automated workflows, or LLM-driven solutions to optimize threat detection, administrative efficiency, or security operations. Flexibility for On-Site Engagement: Willingness and ability to travel as needed for company leadership summits, team planning workshops, and critical customer or auditor engagements. Nice to Have: Senior Certifications: CISSP, CISM, or equivalent senior security credentials. GRC Industry Experience: Experience at a GRC, cybersecurity, or compliance SaaS organization where internal security directly reinforces the commercial value proposition. Scaling Expertise: Background building security programs through major growth events, such as Series C+ scale, IPO preparation, or enterprise market ex

title: Principal AI Engineer
description: Principal AI Engineer (AI / .NET Core / React) At Mitratech, we’re a team of engineers passionate about building world-class products that empower Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR professionals at Fortune 100 companies. We thrive in a global, inclusive culture that values innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. With continued growth, we’re looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join our HotDocs Team . HotDocs is Mitratech’s flagship document automation platform, used by enterprise clients worldwide to streamline the assembly of complex legal documents and contracts. You'll set the technical direction for AI at HotDocs - designing and delivering new AI-powered enterprise capabilities and driving our adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle. This is a remote-first role.   About the Role As a Principal AI Engineer, you will:       Set the AI Technical Direction: Own the architecture for AI capabilities across HotDocs - model management, LLM and agent orchestration, retrieval strategy, evaluation, cost and latency management - and translate it into a pragmatic delivery roadmap.       Deliver Enterprise AI Features: Take new AI-powered features from prototype to production at enterprise scale, writing clean, maintainable code in .NET Core and React and holding the bar for performance, security, and readability.       Drive AI Adoption in the SDLC: Lead how we use AI across engineering - coding assistants, agentic workflows, test generation, code review, and documentation - selecting tooling, defining safe and effective usage patterns, and measuring the impact on delivery.       Build Trustworthy AI: Establish evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and AI governance practices so that AI features are accurate, explainable, and safe for use in regulated, compliance-heavy environments.       Bring Deep Technical Expertise: Apply strong .NET and React ecosystem knowledge to complex problems, modernize and refactor legacy code where it blocks AI integration, and improve system scalability and reliability.       Lead and Mentor: Raise the AI capability of the wider engineering group through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, brown-bag sessions, and clear written guidance.       Influence Across the Business: Partner with product management, architecture, security, and customer-facing teams to shape the AI roadmap, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and set realistic expectations for what AI can deliver.       Enhance DevOps and AI Ops: Extend CI/CD pipelines to cover AI workloads - prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation gates, monitoring, and cost tracking - working closely with DevOps engineers.       Focus on the User: Ensure AI features solve real customer problems and deliver a great experience through attention to detail, responsiveness, transparency, and accessibility.   About You You are:       A Technical Leader: You set direction without needing authority, build consensus across teams, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical peers.       An AI Practitioner, not a Spectator: You have shipped AI features to real users, keep pace with a fast-moving field, and can tell genuine capability from hype.       Evidence-Led: You care about maintainable code, testing, and measurable outcomes - you evaluate AI systems with data rather than intuition.       Adaptable and Pragmatic: You balance long-term architectural goals with the practical needs of a sprint-driven environment, and you know when a simple solution beats a model.       Security-, Privacy- and Performance-Minded : You build with scalability and resilience in mind, using secure-by-design principles, and you treat data privacy and responsible AI as first-order concerns.   Required Skills and Experience       12 or more years of professional software development experience, including time in a principal, lead, or staff-level technical role.       Strong skills in .NET Core (C#) and React (TypeScript) or similar SPA frameworks - this remains a hands-on engineering role.       Demonstrable experience designing and shipping production AI solutions - LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, and agentic or tool-calling systems.       Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms and services (e.g. Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, or equivalent) and with orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel.       Experience building and maintaining REST APIs .       Proficiency with Entity Framework and Azure SQL (or SQL Server).       Experience evaluating and improving AI system quality - test sets, benchmarking, human review loops, and handling non-deterministic behavior.       Understanding of web applications and AI-specific security, including secure coding, prompt injection, and safe handling of sensitive customer data.       Experience using Git and collaborating through modern workflows (e.g., pull requests, branching strategies).       Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar).       Comfortable working in agile teams using tools such as Jira and Confluence.       Practical experience using AI tooling within the SDLC (e.g. coding assistants, agentic developer tools) and a view on how to adopt it well across a team.       A track record of technical leadership - mentoring senior engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing roadmap and architecture decisions.   Nice to Have       Deeper AI specialism in areas such as SLMs and fine-tuning, CAG, vector databases, AI observability, multi-agent systems, or AI/ML pipelines.       Experience with Microsoft Office Addins (office.js / VSTO)       Familiarity of .NET Framework / WPF       Experience with authentication standards such as OAuth and SSO .       Exposure to distributed caching (e.g., Redis)       Knowledge of Linux environments and containerization (Docker).       Scripting in PowerShell .       Familiarity with performance tuning and application diagnostics.       Experience with infrastructure-as-code or automation tooling.       Previous experience in enterprise SaaS or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., legaltech, fintech), particularly applying AI to document, contract, or natural language workloads.   What We Offer       A collaborative, supportive, and learning-focused work culture.       The chance to shape an AI strategy end to end, from architecture through to production, at enterprise scale.       Opportunities to grow your technical skills and career path.       Remote-first flexibility with optional in-person collaboration sessions.       Competitive benefits and a chance to impact how global organizations automate critical legal and compliance workflows.   Join Us Ready to lead the application of AI to document automation at enterprise scale? Apply now to join Mitratech’s innovative, inclusive, and driven HotDocs engineering team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal, Agentic Engineering Platform

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role AI is fundamentally transforming how professional services teams build and deliver value. At Elastic, we are focused on creating production-grade services platforms and software engineering practices that work reliably in real-world environments. The agentic engineering platform is a suite of tools designed to automate complex, multi-step delivery workflows across our global services organization. We are looking for a Principal, Agentic Engineering Platform to lead this initiative end-to-end. In this role, you will design, ship, and refine agentic systems that directly support our services team. You will set technical standards, guide product strategy, and manage the complete life cycle: building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and iterating. While automated agents expand what you can deliver, you are the architect and decision-maker responsible for the final outcome. Manage the platform roadmap and release schedule, overseeing stages from discovery and classification to quality assurance and rollout. Develop multi-step workflows using LLM orchestration, tool integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and structured output processing. Guide AI-assisted development workflows with tools like Claude Code and Codex, emphasizing issue-focused tasks, automated testing, and security reviews. Design robust system architecture that addresses operational boundaries, potential failure modes, human approval steps, and long-term maintainability. Evaluation, Quality & Observability: Create and maintain evaluation frameworks to assess agent performance across accuracy, reliability, response time, cost, and stability. Implement tracing across tool calls, context assembly, and decision logic to troubleshoot and resolve production issues quickly. Define quality benchmarks for professional services workflows and build system metrics to validate them. Incorporate human review checkpoints wherever model output affects client deliverables or operational risk. Field Integration & Collaboration: Ensure platform outputs generate clear evidence suitable for client deliverables, including proposals, statements of work, and project estimates. Act as the key technical link between services platform engineering and delivery teams, working closely with stakeholders to seamlessly integrate agentic workflows into existing processes. Partner with Services Practice Leads and the Global Specialist to turn operational strategies into practical tools. What You Bring 10+ years of experience in platform engineering, software engineering, or technical professional services roles. Proven track record of deploying agentic or LLM-powered applications to production, with experience navigating the full deployment and optimization life cycle. Practical experience with LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, tool integration, and RAG architectures. Experience building evaluation systems, test suites, and monitoring tools for probabilistic models. Familiarity with developer tooling (such as Claude Code or Codex) and agent framework patterns. Strong Python engineering skills, with the ability to review backend services and data structures for production readiness. Focus on security best practices, including access control, least privilege, air-gapped setups, and safe handling of sensitive customer data. Strong communication skills, capable of explaining technical trade-offs and deployment risks to non-technical stakeholders. Willingness to travel up to 15% as needed. Bonus Points Domain experience in SIEM, observability, or data migration (e.g., detections, ECS, Kibana Security, SPL). Familiarity with Elastic workflows, such as Kibana SIEM migrations, DIMA, or related migration tooling. Experience using Elasticsearch as a retrieval or search layer within agentic systems. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide. Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers. The Senior Manager of Cyber Governance & Assurance will lead and mature the enterprise cybersecurity governance program, establishing an effective operating model for policies, standards, control governance, cyber risk management and cyber assurance. This leader will partner with Cybersecurity, Technology, Legal, Privacy, Enterprise Risk and Internal Audit to translate regulatory and security requirements into actional controls, drive clear accountability and provide leadership with measurable visibility into compliance posture, control effectiveness and cyber risk. Advise senior leaders on cybersecurity governance, regulatory obligations and material cyber risk; present clear option, recommendations and decisions required. Lead monthly, quarterly annual priorities, resource planning, change adoption and performance management; establish an inclusive, accountable team culture and develop team members. Demonstrated experience presenting to senior leadership, effectively communication performance, risks and strategic priorities while confidently addressing challenging questions and driving executive alignment. title: DevOps Team Manager
description: Bromcom Computers Plc is the UK's fastest-growing cloud-native school Management Information System (MIS) provider, serving thousands of schools across three UK countries. The DevOps Team Manager leads a team of 3-4 engineers and is accountable for the reliable, secure and controlled operation of Bromcom's Azure-first SaaS platform. This is a hands-on DevOps engineering leadership role with an expected balance of 70% hands-on DevOps engineering and 30% people and team management. The manager works closely with the engineers, contributes directly to delivery and operations, and owns completion and ongoing maintenance of the agreed DevOps operational control improvements. The role requires a credible engineering background. The successful candidate is expected to work directly across Azure platform engineering, CI/CD, Bicep/ARM, automation, incident response and operational controls, while leading the team and setting standards. They must be able to challenge technical decisions, understand operational risk and failure modes, and ensure agreed processes are implemented, followed, evidenced and continually improved. A control is not complete simply because a policy or tool exists; it must work consistently in practice. Key Responsibilities People & Team Leadership Lead, line-manage and develop a team of 3-4 DevOps engineers, including at least one senior engineer; own recruitment, onboarding, objectives, appraisals and performance management. Set clear role boundaries, decision rights and escalation routes; ensure high-risk activities are performed or approved only by people with the required competence and authority. Own team capacity, priorities and the out-of-hours on-call rota. The manager is expected to take a fair share of scheduled rota cover alongside the engineers and respond to production incidents and urgent operational issues during that cover, including evenings, weekends and bank holidays where required. Ensure rota coverage, handovers, escalation routes and recovery time are planned and sustainable, while protecting time for reliability, control improvement, technical debt, training and documentation. Build an accountable coaching culture in which engineers raise risk early, follow agreed standards, maintain evidence and learn from incidents and control failures. Engineering & Platform Leadership Provide hands-on engineering leadership for Bromcom's Azure-hosted, multi-tenant SaaS platform. Work closely with engineers to design, build, review, troubleshoot and improve platform services, pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code, automation and operational tooling. The manager remains accountable for technical quality while enabling engineers to own their work. Set and maintain engineering standards for Azure architecture, Azure DevOps, Bicep/ARM, deployment patterns, observability, resilience, security and operational support. Challenge designs and changes using risk, maintainability, failure-mode, rollback and supportability thinking; involve senior engineers and technical leadership where specialist authority is required. Own platform SLAs/SLOs, service health, major-incident command, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, business continuity testing and continuous service improvement.
